title: Jubilant Crisp Uruguayan Oreo Pilaf
description: Rich and crispy one-pot Uruguayan dish featuring Oreo cream biscuits, this pilaf is a unique blend of flavors and textures. It is also ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and cooked to perfection on a slate-tile vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large slate-tile vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the crushed Oreo cream biscuits and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the uncooked white rice and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Add the water, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the chopped scallions.
Serve the Jubilant Crisp Uruguayan Oreo Pilaf hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
